title: Evaluation of aortic valve stiffness as a novel parameter for aortic stenosis
summary: Aortic valve stenosis is a common valve disease. In many cases it is difficult to determine the severity of aortic stenosis. We want to study, if a novel parameter (valvular stiffness) is better than conventional parameters.

interventions.name:
Patients with varying degress of aortic stenosis (none to sever)

Baseline visit:
- evaluation of the aortic valve with transthoracic and transoesophageal echocardiography
- 6 minute walking test
- symptom burden (questionnaires)
- blood draw for cardiac biomarkers

Telephone follow-up visit

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Indication for transosophageal echocardiography
Exclusion criteria:
- bicuspid aortic valve
- existing aortic valve replacement
- non-degenerative aortic valve stenosis
- contraindications for  transosophageal echocardiography
- unable to give consent
